title: Permissions, Hidden Information & GM Authority
objective: Implement a bounded provider-neutral permission, hidden-information and GM-authority preservation contract that consumes canonical Multiversal authorization decisions while external VTTs remain derivative presentation clients.
selection_boundaries: VTI-06 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired.
VTI-07 is selected only from exact current application main 1e325045b2fc65d067a5e587f8cde78dcba9f766; no branch, acceptance package, permission behavior or production mutation is authorized yet.
A future governed start may bound provider-neutral ownership, consent, visibility, hidden-information and GM-authority preservation across derivative VTT clients.
VTI-07 must consume canonical Multiversal authorization/visibility decisions and may not make an external VTT authoritative for permissions, adjudication or hidden state.
Hidden counts/content, redacted identities and GM-only material must remain fail-closed with no inference channel.

Provider-specific schemas, vendor selection/ranking, credentials, external accounts, adapter implementation, live external/canonical mutation, durable VTI persistence/new migration, provider activation, tester distribution, release/deployment, VTI-08+ and SGC-01+ remain unauthorized.
